Day in brief

iOS 27 shifts software updates to DDM as Intune ends legacy ADE authentication

The meaningful Intune changes center on retiring legacy Apple enrollment and update controls, alongside tighter Windows deployment options. Apple’s OS 27 guidance moves administrators to Declarative Device Management (DDM) for software updates, while the October 2026 (2610) release ends Setup Assistant (legacy) authentication for ADE with user affinity. Windows Autopilot guidance adds Enterprise App Management app gating and sets a processing cutoff for older Active Directory connectors. Most of the period’s 3,079 updates were mechanical metadata or link changes, particularly in Configuration Manager.

  • Intune · Device updates
    Apple moves iOS/iPadOS software-update controls to DDM

    The planning guidance states that Apple deprecated MDM-based software-update workloads and removed related commands with OS 27. It directs administrators to Software Update enforcement and Software Update Settings, with enforcement based on each device’s local time zone.

  • Intune · Device enrollment
    Intune ends Setup Assistant legacy authentication for ADE user affinity

    Support for Setup Assistant (legacy) authentication for Automated Device Enrollment with user affinity ended in the October 2026 (2610) service release. Existing profiles are automatically updated to modern authentication, and the legacy option is no longer available.

  • Windows Autopilot · Device enrollment
    Older Intune AD connectors can no longer process Autopilot enrollments

    Intune Connector for Active Directory versions older than 6.2501.2000.5 are deprecated and can no longer process enrollment requests. Connector version 6.2504.2001.8 uses WebView2, removing the documented need to disable Internet Explorer Enhanced Security Configuration on Windows Server.

  • Windows Autopilot · Device enrollment
    Autopilot device preparation can gate setup on Enterprise App Management apps

    Windows Autopilot device preparation policies can select Microsoft Intune Enterprise App Management auto-update apps and block setup until those apps are installed, allowing selected required applications to be present before users reach the desktop.

  • Intune · General
    In-development guidance details a Defender Safe Deployment template

    Intune’s in-development guidance describes a dedicated template for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint safe deployment settings on Windows, including separate update channels for platform, engine, and security intelligence updates.

This period briefing was generated by AI from the tracked Microsoft Learn and Message Center changes.

Ref Automated Authentication Methods

Retirement

Intune ended support for Setup Assistant (legacy) authentication for iOS/iPadOS and macOS automated device enrollment with user affinity in the October 2026 (2610) service release. Existing profiles are automatically updated to Setup Assistant with modern authentication, and the legacy option is no longer available for new or edited profiles.

Guide Ios Ipados

Retirement

Intune ended support for Setup Assistant (legacy) authentication for Automated Device Enrollment with user affinity in the October 2026 (2610) service release. Existing profiles are automatically updated to Setup Assistant with modern authentication, and the documentation now recommends modern authentication with JIT registration.

Setup Automated Ios

Retirement

School Manager Step 2

Feature update

For Apple School Manager enrollment with User Affinity, the guidance now lists Setup Assistant with modern authentication (recommended) and Company Portal, removing the legacy Setup Assistant option. Both methods support multifactor authentication and password change or reset prompts; JIT registration is recommended for iOS/iPadOS ADE with User Affinity.
